pp2.4:106.6: attanā vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti no paraṃ vimuttināṇadassanasampadāya samādapeti:
pp2.4:106.7: evaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya.
pp2.4:107.1: Kathañ ca puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya?
pp2.4:107.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo attanā na sīlasampanno hoti paraṃ sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:107.3: attanā na samādhisampanno hoti paraṃ samādhisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:107.4: attanā na paññāsampanno hoti paraṃ paññāsampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:107.5: attanā na vimuttisampanno hoti vimuttisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:107.6: attanā na vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti paraṃ vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya samādapeti:
pp2.4:107.7: evaṃ puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno hoti no attahitāya.
pp2.4:108.1: Kathañ ca puggalo attahitāya c' eva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca?
pp2.4:108.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti parañ ca sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:108.3: attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti parañ ca samādhisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:108.4: attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti parañ ca paññāsampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:108.5: attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti parañ ca vimuttisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:108.6: attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti parañ ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya samādapeti:
pp2.4:108.7: puggalo attahitāya c' eva paṭipanno hoti parahitāya ca.
pp2.4:109.1: Kathañ ca puggalo n' eva attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya?
pp2.4:109.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo attanā na sīlasampanno hoti no paraṃ sīlasampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:109.3: attanā na samādhisampanno hoti no paraṃ samādhisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:109.4: attanā na paññāsampanno hoti no paraṃ paññāsampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:109.5: attanā na vimuttisampanno hoti no paraṃ vimuttisampadāya samādapeti,
pp2.4:109.6: attanā na vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti no paraṃ vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadāya samādapeti;
pp2.4:109.7: evaṃ puggalo n' eva attahitāya paṭipanno hoti no parahitāya. 24.
pp2.4:110.1: Kathañ ca puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogum anuyutto?
pp2.4:110.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo acelako hoti muttācāro hatthāpalekhaṇo, na-ehi-bhadantiko na-tiṭṭha-bhadantiko nābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati, so na kumbhimukhā paṭigaṇhāti na khaḷopimukhā paṭigaṇhāti, na eḷakamantaraṃ na daṇḍamantaraṃ na musalamantaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na purisantaragatāya, na saṅkittisu, na yattha sā upaṭṭhito hoti, na yattha makkhikā saṇḍasaṇḍacārinī, na macchaṃ na maṃsaṃ, na suraṃ na merayaṃ na thusodakam pivati:
pp2.4:110.3: so ekāgāriko vā hoti ekālopiko dvāgāriko vā hoti dvālopiko . . . pe . . .
pp2.4:110.5: ekissāpi dattiyā yāpeti dvīhi pi dattīhi yāpeti . . . pe . . .
pp2.4:110.7: ekāhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti dvīhikam pi āhāraṃ āhāreti . . . pe . . .
pp2.4:110.9: iti evarūpaṃ aḍḍhamāsikam pi pariyāyabhattabhojanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
pp2.4:110.10: so sākabhakkho vā hoti sāmākabhakkho vā hoti nīvārabhakkho vā hoti daddulabhakkho vā hoti sātabhakkho vā hoti kaṇabhakkho vā hoti ācāmabhakkho vā hoti piññākabhakkho vā hoti tiṇabhakkho vā hoti gomayabhakkho vā hoti, vanamūlaphalāhāro yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī:
pp2.4:110.11: so sāṇāni pi dhāreti masāṇāni pi dhāreti chavadussāni pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni pi dhāreti tirīṭāni pi dhāreti ajināni pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam pi dhāreti kusacīram pi dhāreti vākacīram pi dhāreti phalakacīram pi dhāreti kesakambalam pi dhāreti vālakambalam pi dhāreti ulūkapakkhikam pi dhāreti, kesamassulocako pi hoti kesamassulocanānuyogam anuyutto, ubbhaṭṭhako pi hoti āsanapaṭikkhitto, ukkuṭiko pi hoti ukkuṭikappadhānaṃ anuyutto, kaṇṭakāpassayiko pi hoti kaṇṭakāpassaye seyyaṃ kappeti, sāyaṃ tatiyakam pi udakorohanānuyogam anuyutto viharati,
pp2.4:110.12: iti evarūpaṃ anekavihitaṃ kāyassa ātāpanaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto viharati;
pp2.4:110.13: evaṃ puggalo attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
pp2.4:111.1: Kathañ ca puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto?
pp2.4:111.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo orabbhiko hoti sūkariko māgaviko sākuṇiko luddo macchaghātako coro coraghātako bandhanāgāriko, ye vā pan' aññe pi keci kurūrakammantā:
pp2.4:111.3: evaṃ puggalo parantapo hoti paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
pp2.4:112.1: Kathañ ca puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogamanuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto?
pp2.4:112.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo rājā vā hoti khattiyo maddhāvasitto brāhmaṇo vā mahāsālo,
pp2.4:112.3: so puratthimena nagarassa navayaññāgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kharājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā migavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno yaññāgāraṃ pavisati saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena,
pp2.4:112.4: so tattha anantarahitāya bhūmiyā haritūpalittāya seyyaṃ kappeti;
pp2.4:112.5: ekissā gāviyā sarūpavacchāya yaṃ ekasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti tena rājā yāpeti, yaṃ dutiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti tena mahesī yāpeti, yaṃ tatiyasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti tena brāhmaṇo purohito yāpeti, yaṃ catutthasmiṃ thane khīraṃ hoti tena aggiṃ juhanti, avasesena vacchako yāpeti;
pp2.4:112.7: ettakā usabhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatarā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā vacchatariyo haññantu yaññathāya, ettakā ajā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññatthāya, ettakā rukkhā chijjantu yūpatthāya, ettakā dubbā lūyantu barihisatthāyā ti
pp2.4:112.8: ye pi' ssa honti dāsā ti vā pessā ti vā kammakārā ti vā te pi daṇḍatajjitā bhayatajjitā assumukhā rudamānā parikammāni karonti:
pp2.4:112.9: evaṃ puggalo attantapo ca hoti attaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto parantapo ca paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto.
pp2.4:113.1: Kathañ ca puggalo n' eva attantapo hoti attaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto na parantapo paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto?
pp2.4:113.2: So anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭh' eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati.
pp2.4:114.1: Idha Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā:
pp2.4:114.2: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrāhmaṇaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇaṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti,
pp2.4:114.3: so dhammaṃ deseti ādi kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāne kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
pp2.4:114.4: Taṃ dhammaṃ suṇāti gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aññatarasmiṃ vā kule paccājāto,
pp2.4:114.5: so taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā Tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhati.
pp2.4:114.6: So tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhati
pp2.4:114.8: na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasato ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikkhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ,
pp2.4:114.9: yaṃ nunāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan ti:
pp2.4:114.10: so aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya, mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya, appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya, mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya, kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajati.
pp2.4:115.1: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati:
pp2.4:116.1: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharati;
pp2.4:117.1: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī hoti anācārī paṭivirato methunā gāmadhammā,
pp2.4:118.1: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa,
pp2.4:119.1: pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amusaṃ bhedāya,
pp2.4:119.2: iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti,
pp2.4:120.1: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusavācā paṭivirato hoti,
pp2.4:120.2: yā sā vācā neḷā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti,
pp2.4:121.1: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
pp2.4:122.1: So bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato hoti, ekabhattiko hoti, rattūparato vikālabhojanā, naccagītavāditavisūkadassanā paṭivirato hoti, mālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti, uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato hoti, jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti,
pp2.4:123.1: āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, itthikumāripaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, dāsidāsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, ajeḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, hatthigavāssavaḷavapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti, dūteyyapahīṇagamanānuyogā paṭivirato hoti, kayavikkayā paṭivirato hoti, tulākūṭakaṃsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭivirato hoti, ukkoṭanavañcananikatisāciyogā paṭivirato hoti chedanavadhabandhanaviparāmosa-ālopasahasākārā paṭivirato hoti.
pp2.4:124.1: So santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena,
pp2.4:124.2: so yena yen' eva pakkamati, samādāy' eva pakkamati: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhisakuṇo yena yen' eva ḍeti sapattabhāro va ḍeti,
pp2.4:124.3: evam evaṃ bhikkhu santuṭṭho hoti kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena,
pp2.4:124.4: yena yen' eva pakkamati samāday' eva pakkamati:
pp2.4:124.5: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
pp2.4:125.1: So cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.4:125.2: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati:
pp2.4:125.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī
pp2.4:125.8: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati rakkhati manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati:
pp2.4:125.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ avyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti.
pp2.4:126.1: So abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī hoti, ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī hoti, sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī hoti, saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī hoti, asite pite khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī hoti, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakāri hoti, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī hoti.
pp2.4:127.1: So iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato imāya ca ariyāya santuṭṭhiyā samannāgato vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati āraññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ:
pp2.4:127.2: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā:
pp2.4:127.3: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.4:127.4: vyāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī vyāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.4:127.5: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodhati:
pp2.4:127.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti:
pp2.4:127.7: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
pp2.4:128.1: So ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
pp2.4:128.2: vitakkavicārāṇaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
pp2.4:128.3: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
pp2.4:128.4: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhim catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
pp2.4:129.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgane vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti:
pp2.4:129.3: ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo tisso pi jātiyo catasso pi jātiyo pañca pi jātiyo dasa pi jātiyo vīsam pi jātiyo tiṃsam pi jātiyo cattārīsam pi jātiyo paññāsam pi jātiyo jātisatam pi jātisahassam pi jātisatasahassam pi aneke pi saṃvaṭṭakappe aneke pi vivaṭṭakappe aneke pi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe:
pp2.4:129.4: amutrāsim evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ,
pp2.4:129.5: tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto, so tato cuto idhūpapanno ti
pp2.4:129.6: iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
pp2.4:130.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgane vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjapatte sattānaṃ cutupapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti:
pp2.4:130.2: so dibbena cakkhunā suddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti --
pp2.4:130.3: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā manoduccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā
pp2.4:130.4: te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā --
pp2.4:130.5: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā, vacīsucaritena samannāgatā, manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhikammasamādānā
pp2.4:130.6: te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā ti;
pp2.4:130.7: so iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
pp2.4:131.1: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammanīye ṭhite ānejjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmeti:
pp2.4:131.2: so idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . . . pe . . . ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti:
pp2.4:131.3: ime āsavā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, ayaṃ āsavasamudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, . . . pe . . . ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
pp2.4:131.4: Tassa evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavā pi cittaṃ vimuccati,
pp2.4:131.6: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
pp2.4:131.7: Evaṃ puggalo n' eva attantapo hoti na attaparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto na parantapo na paraparitāpanānuyogam anuyutto: so ca
pp2.4:131.8: anattantapo aparantapo diṭṭh' eva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto sukhapaṭisaṃvedī brahmabhūtena attanā viharati. 25.
pp2.4:132.2: Yassa puggalassa rāgo appahīṇo, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sarāgo.
pp2.4:133.2: Yassa puggalassa doso appahīṇo, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo sadoso.
pp2.4:134.2: Yassa puggalassā moho appahīṇo, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo samoho.
pp2.4:135.2: Yassa puggalassa māno appahīṇo, ayaṃ vuccati puggalo samāno. 26.
pp2.4:136.1: Kathañ ca puggalo lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhi adhipaññādhammavipassanāya?
pp2.4:136.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahatagānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ, na lābhī lokuttaramaggassa vā phalassa vā,
pp2.4:136.3: evaṃ puggalo lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
pp2.4:137.1: Kathañ ca puggalo lābhī hoti addhipaññādhammavipassanāya na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa?
pp2.4:137.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti lokuttaramaggassa vā phalassa vā, na lābhī rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ:
pp2.4:137.3: evaṃ puggalo lābhī hoti adhipaññādhammavipassanāya na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa.
pp2.4:138.1: Kathañ ca puggalo lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya?
pp2.4:138.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ lābhī lokuttaramaggassa vā phalassa vā,
pp2.4:138.3: evaṃ puggalo lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. Kathañ ca
pp2.4:139.1: puggalo n' eva lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya?
pp2.4:139.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo n' eva lābhī hoti rūpasahagatānaṃ vā arūpasahagatānaṃ vā samāpattīnaṃ, na labhī lokuttaramaggassa vā phalassa vā,
pp2.4:139.3: evaṃ puggalo n' eva lābhī hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 27.
pp2.4:140.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kāme ca paṭisevati pāpañca kammaṃ karoti,
pp2.4:141.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo kāme ca na paṭisevati pāpañca kammaṃ na karoti,
pp2.4:141.3: so sahā pi dukkhena sahā pi domanassena assumukhena pi rudamāno paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati,
pp2.4:142.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha-parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā,
pp2.4:143.1: Katamo ca puggalo tiṇṇo pāraṅgato phale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo?
pp2.4:143.2: Idh' ekacco puggalo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
pp2.4:143.3: ayaṃ vuccati puggalo tiṇṇo pāraṅgato phale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo. 28.
pp2.4:144.1: Kathañ ca puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anupapanno?
pp2.4:144.2: Idh' ekaccassa puggalassa appakaṃ sutaṃ hoti suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
pp2.4:144.3: so tassa appakassa sutassa na attham aññāya na dhammam aññāya na dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
pp2.4:144.4: evaṃ puggalo appassuto hoti sutena anupapanno.

pp2.4:146.4: evaṃ puggalo bahussuto hoti sutena anupapanno.
